scripts.fresh-yugioh-import: bun run scripts/yugioh/resetAndImport.ts && bun run scripts/yugioh/importData.ts
scripts.test-yugioh-models: bun -e "import('./src/database/db/db').then(async ({connectDB}) => { await connectDB(); const {YugiohCard, YugiohSet} = await import('./src/database/models/yugioh/index'); const cardCount = await YugiohCard.countDocuments(); const setCount = await YugiohSet.countDocuments(); console.log('✅ Cards:', cardCount, 'Sets:', setCount); process.exit(0); })"
scripts.check-yugioh-data: bun -e "import('./src/database/db/db').then(async ({connectDB}) => { await connectDB(); const mongoose = await import('mongoose'); const oldCount = await mongoose.default.connection.db.collection('yugiohcards').countDocuments(); console.log('📊 Current Yugioh cards:', oldCount); process.exit(0); })"
scripts.check-all-collections: bun -e "import('./src/database/db/db').then(async ({connectDB}) => { await connectDB(); const mongoose = await import('mongoose'); const collections = await mongoose.default.connection.db.listCollections().toArray(); console.log('📋 Collections:'); collections.forEach(c => console.log('  -', c.name)); const cards = await mongoose.default.connection.db.collection('yugiohcards').countDocuments(); const sets = await mongoose.default.connection.db.collection('yugiohsets').countDocuments(); console.log('📊 yugiohcards:', cards, 'yugiohsets:', sets); process.exit(0); })"
